mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that impair everolimus clearance and increase its nephrotoxic effects; combined renal toxicity and potential CYP3A4 inhibition by amphotericin B may elevate everolimus levels.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and everolimus levels closely; consider alternative antifungal agents (azoles, echinocandins) when possible; maintain adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation; adjust everolimus dose if renal impairment develops.
